Each MPI rank owns a\n//    contiguous range of tile rows, resident on its own GPU.\n//  * Blocked Floyd-Warshall: for every pivot tile index kb\n//       phase 1: diagonal tile (kb,kb)            -- owner of tile row kb\n//       phase 2: row panel (kb,*)                 -- owner of tile row kb\n//                -> broadcast to all ranks (MPI, staged through pinned memory)\n//       phase 2: column tiles (*,kb)              -- every rank, its own rows\n//       phase 3: all remaining tiles              -- every rank, its own rows\n//    The owner of tile row kb+1 computes the next row panel first (lookahead), so\n//    its broadcast overlaps with the bulk phase-3 work of step kb.\n//  * OpenMP parallelizes host-side work (graph generation with an exact rand_r\n//    jump-ahead, path decoding, buffer packing).\n//\n// Path semantics: the original algorithm stores in path[i][j] the last pivot k that\n// strictly improved dist[i][j] (or i if never improved). The blocked\n// algorithm therefore runs over the lexicographic (distance, maxIntermediate+1)\n// semiring, which is closed under reordering and yields bit-identical dist and path.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Tile edge length and thread-block shape (16x16 threads, 4x4 elements each)\nconstexpr int TILE = 64;\nconstexpr int TPB_X = 16;\nconstexpr int TPB_Y = 16;\nconstexpr int PER_T = TILE / TPB_X;  // 4\n// Distance used for padding nodes: never improves anything, sums never overflow\nconstexpr unsigned int PAD_DIST = 0x3fffffffu;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                            \\\n    do {                                                                            \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                 \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                 \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err__),  \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                           \\\n        }                                                                           \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Device code. nd : cd;\n    cm = better ? nm : cm;\n}\n\n// Dependent phases (1 and 2): tile T is updated in place using the pivot block.\n//  MODE 0: diagonal tile      T = T (x) T\n//  MODE 1: row-panel tile     T = P (x) T     (P = diagonal tile, final)\n//  MODE 2: column tile        T = T (x) P\n// Entries (i,kk) and (kk,j) never change during step kk (diagonal is (0,0) and the\n// candidate through kk has m >= kk+1), so a single sync per step suffices.\ntemplate <int MODE>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TPB_X * TPB_Y)\ndependentKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ D, unsigned int* __restrict__ M, const size_t ld,\n                const unsigned int* __restrict__ PD, const unsigned int* __restrict__ PM,\n                const size_t pld, const int tileRow0, const int tileCol0,\n                const int skipTile, const int kb) {\n    __shared__ unsigned int sD[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sM[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPD[MODE == 0 ? 1 : TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPM[MODE == 0 ? 1 : TILE][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int t = blockIdx.x;\n    if (t == skipTile) return;\n    // MODE 1 iterates over tile columns, MODE 2 over (local) tile rows\n    const size_t row0 = (size_t)(MODE == 2 ? sPD[kk][j] : sD[kk][j];\n                const unsigned int bm = (MODE == 2) ? sPM[kk][j] : sM[kk][j];\n                const unsigned int nd = ad + bd;\n                const unsigned int nm = max(max(am, bm), kVal);\n                const unsigned int cd = sD[i][j];\n                const unsigned int cm = sM[i][j];\n                if ((nd < cd) || (nd == cd && nm < cm)) {\n                    sD[i][j] = nd;\n                    sM[i][j] = nm;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n        const int i = ty + TPB_Y * r;\n        for (int c = 0; c < PER_T; ++c) {\n            const int j = tx + TPB_X * c;\n            D[(row0 + i) * ld + col0 + j] = sD[i][j];\n            M[(row0 + i) * ld + col0 + j] = sM[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Shared memory layout of the independent phase (A stored transposed)\nconstexpr int SA_LD = TILE + 4;  // keeps 16-byte alignment, reduces bank conflicts\nconstexpr size_t PHASE3_SMEM = (size_t)(2 * TILE * SA_LD + 2 * TILE * TILE) * sizeof(unsigned int);\n\n// Independent phase 3: C(I,J) = C (x) A(I,kb) (x) P(kb,J) for all local tile rows in\n// [tRow0, tRow0 + gridDim.y) and all tile columns except kb. A and P are final.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TPB_X * TPB_Y, 2)\nindependentKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ D, unsigned int* __restrict__ M, const size_t ld,\n                  const unsigned int* __restrict__ PD, const unsigned int* __restrict__ PM,\n                  const int tRow0, const int skipRow, const int kb) {\n    const int J = blockIdx.x;\n    const int I = tRow0 + blockIdx.y;\n    if (J == kb || I == skipRow) return;\n\n    extern __shared__ __align__(16) unsigned int smem[];\n    unsigned int* sAd = smem; e < TILE * TILE / 4; e += TPB_X * TPB_Y) {\n        const int i = e / (TILE / 4);\n        const int q = (e % (TILE / 4)) * 4;\n        const uint4 ad = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&D[(row0 + i) * ld + kcol0 + q]);\n        const uint4 am = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&M[(row0 + i) * ld + kcol0 + q]);\n        sAd[(q + 0) * SA_LD + i] = ad.x; sAd[(q + 1) * SA_LD + i] = ad.y;\n        sAd[(q + 2) * SA_LD + i] = ad.z; sAd[(q + 3) * SA_LD + i] = ad.w;\n        sAm[(q + 0) * SA_LD + i] = am.x; sAm[(q + 1) * SA_LD + i] = am.y;\n        sAm[(q + 2) * SA_LD + i] = am.z; sAm[(q + 3) * SA_LD + i] = am.w;\n\n        const uint4 bd = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&PD[(size_t)i * ld + col0 + q]);\n        uint4 bm = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&PM[(size_t)i * ld + col0 + q]);\n        const unsigned int kv = kBase + i;\n        bm.x = max(bm.x, kv); bm.y = max(bm.y, kv); bm.z = max(bm.z, kv); bm.w = max(bm.w, kv);\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&sBd[i * TILE + q]) = bd;\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&sBm[i * TILE + q]) = bm;\n    }\n\n    // Load own 4x4 block of C into registers: rows ty*4+r, cols tx*4+c\n    unsigned int cd[PER_T][PER_T], cm[PER_T][PER_T];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n        const size_t g = (row0 + ty * PER_T + r) * ld + col0 + tx * PER_T;\n        const uint4 vd = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&D[g]);\n        const uint4 vm = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&M[g]);\n        cd[r][0] = vd.x; cd[r][1] = vd.y; cd[r][2] = vd.z; cd[r][3] = vd.w;\n        cm[r][0] = vm.x; cm[r][1] = vm.y; cm[r][2] = vm.z; cm[r][3] = vm.w;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int kk = 0; kk < TILE; ++kk) {\n        const uint4 a4d = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sAd[kk * SA_LD + ty * PER_T]);\n        const uint4 a4m = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sAm[kk * SA_LD + ty * PER_T]);\n        const uint4 b4d = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sBd[kk * TILE + tx * PER_T]);\n        const uint4 b4m = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sBm[kk * TILE + tx * PER_T]);\n        const unsigned int ad[4] = {a4d.x, a4d.y, a4d.z, a4d.w};\n        const unsigned int am[4] = {a4m.x, a4m.y, a4m.z, a4m.w};\n        const unsigned int bd[4] = {b4d.x, b4d.y, b4d.z, b4d.w};\n        const unsigned int bm[4] = {b4m.x, b4m.y, b4m.z, b4m.w};\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n        const size_t g = (row0 + ty * PER_T + r) * ld + col0 + tx * PER_T;\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&D[g]) = make_uint4(cd[r][0], cd[r][1], cd[r][2], cd[r][3]);\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&M[g]) = make_uint4(cm[r][0], cm[r][1], cm[r][2], cm[r][3]);\n    }\n}\n\n// Convert m-encoding to the original path convention: path[i][j] = m-1, or i if m==0\n__global__ void decodePathKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ M, const size_t ld,\n                                 const size_t rows, const size_t globalRow0) {\n    const size_t total = rows * ld;\n    for (size_t e = blockIdx.x * (size_t)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; e < total;\n         e += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const unsigned int m = M[e];\n        M[e] = m ? m - 1 : (unsigned int)(globalRow0 + e / ld);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Advance an LCG state x -> a*x + c (mod 2^32) by 'steps' steps\nstatic unsigned int lcgJump(unsigned int x, uint64_t steps) {\n    unsigned int a = 1103515245u, c = 12345u;  // glibc rand_r LCG\n    unsigned int accA = 1u, accC = 0u;\n    while (steps) {\n        if (steps & 1) {\n            accA = accA * a;\n            accC = accC * a + c;\n        }\n        c = c * a + c;\n        a = a * a;\n        steps >>= 1;\n    }\n    return accA * x + accC;\n}\n\n// Check that rand_r advances its state by three LCG steps per call (glibc)\nstatic bool randJumpSupported() {\n    unsigned int s = 42;\n    for (int t = 1; Matches the sequential rand_r stream exactly.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(unsigned int* dist, const size_t numNodes, const size_t ld,\n                              const size_t gRow0, const size_t gRow1, const size_t padRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const bool jump = randJumpSupported();\n\n    auto genRow = [&](const size_t gi, unsigned int& seed) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + (gi - gRow0) * ld;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            row[j] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n        }\n        for (size_t j = numNodes; j < ld; ++j) row[j] = PAD_DIST;\n        // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n        row[gi] = 0;\n    };\n\n    if (jump) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t gi = gRow0; gi < gRow1; ++gi) {\n            unsigned int seed = lcgJump(42u, 3ull * gi * numNodes);\n            genRow(gi, seed);\n        }\n    } else {\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t s = 0; s < gRow0 * numNodes; ++s) rand_r(&seed);\n        for (size_t gi = gRow0; gi < gRow1; ++gi) genRow(gi, seed);\n    }\n\n    // Padding rows (beyond numNodes): isolated nodes\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t p = 0; p < padRows; ++p) {\n        const size_t gi = gRow1 + p;\n        unsigned int* row = dist + (gi - gRow0) * ld;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < ld; ++j) row[j] = PAD_DIST;\n        row[gi] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, sPD[kk][j] : sD[kk][j];\n                const unsigned int bm = (MODE == 2) ? sPM[kk][j] : sM[kk][j];\n                const unsigned int nd = ad + bd;\n                const unsigned int nm = max(max(am, bm), kVal);\n                const unsigned int cd = sD[i][j];\n                const unsigned int cm = sM[i][j];\n                if ((nd < cd) || (nd == cd && nm < cm)) {\n                    sD[i][j] = nd;\n                    sM[i][j] = nm;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n        const int i = ty + TPB_Y * r;\n        for (int c = 0; c < PER_T; ++c) {\n            const int j = tx + TPB_X * c;\n            D[(row0 + i) * ld + col0 + j] = sD[i][j];\n            M[(row0 + i) * ld + col0 + j] = sM[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Shared memory layout of the independent phase (A stored transposed)\nconstexpr int SA_LD = TILE + 4;  // keeps 16-byte alignment, reduces bank conflicts\nconstexpr size_t PHASE3_SMEM = (size_t)(2 * TILE * SA_LD + 2 * TILE * TILE) * sizeof(unsigned int);\n\n// Independent phase 3: C(I,J) = C (x) A(I,kb) (x) P(kb,J) for all local tile rows in\n// [tRow0, tRow0 + gridDim.y) and all tile columns except kb. A and P are final.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TPB_X * TPB_Y, 2)\nindependentKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ D, unsigned int* __restrict__ M, const size_t ld,\n                  const unsigned int* __restrict__ PD, const unsigned int* __restrict__ PM,\n                  const int tRow0, const int skipRow, const int kb) {\n    const int J = blockIdx.x;\n    const int I = tRow0 + blockIdx.y;\n    if (J == kb || I == skipRow) return;\n\n    extern __shared__ __align__(16) unsigned int smem[];\n    unsigned int* sAd = smem;                     // [TILE][SA_LD], transposed: [kk][i]\n    unsigned int* sAm = sAd + TILE * SA_LD;\n    unsigned int* sBd = sAm + TILE * SA_LD;       // [TILE][TILE]: [kk][j]\n    unsigned int* sBm = sBd + TILE * TILE;\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x, ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int tid = ty * TPB_X + tx;\n    const size_t row0 = (size_t)I * TILE;\n    const size_t col0 = (size_t)J * TILE;\n    const size_t kcol0 = (size_t)kb * TILE;\n    const unsigned int kBase = (unsigned int)kb * TILE + 1;\n\n    // Load A (column tile) transposed and B (row-panel tile) with m pre-maxed by k+1\n    for (int e = tid; e < TILE * TILE / 4; e += TPB_X * TPB_Y) {\n        const int i = e / (TILE / 4);\n        const int q = (e % (TILE / 4)) * 4;\n        const uint4 ad = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&D[(row0 + i) * ld + kcol0 + q]);\n        const uint4 am = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&M[(row0 + i) * ld + kcol0 + q]);\n        sAd[(q + 0) * SA_LD + i] = ad.x; sAd[(q + 1) * SA_LD + i] = ad.y;\n        sAd[(q + 2) * SA_LD + i] = ad.z; sAd[(q + 3) * SA_LD + i] = ad.w;\n        sAm[(q + 0) * SA_LD + i] = am.x; sAm[(q + 1) * SA_LD + i] = am.y;\n        sAm[(q + 2) * SA_LD + i] = am.z; sAm[(q + 3) * SA_LD + i] = am.w;\n\n        const uint4 bd = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&PD[(size_t)i * ld + col0 + q]);\n        uint4 bm = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&PM[(size_t)i * ld + col0 + q]);\n        const unsigned int kv = kBase + i;\n        bm.x = max(bm.x, kv); bm.y = max(bm.y, kv); bm.z = max(bm.z, kv); bm.w = max(bm.w, kv);\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&sBd[i * TILE + q]) = bd;\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&sBm[i * TILE + q]) = bm;\n    }\n\n    // Load own 4x4 block of C into registers: rows ty*4+r, cols tx*4+c\n    unsigned int cd[PER_T][PER_T], cm[PER_T][PER_T];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n        const size_t g = (row0 + ty * PER_T + r) * ld + col0 + tx * PER_T;\n        const uint4 vd = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&D[g]);\n        const uint4 vm = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&M[g]);\n        cd[r][0] = vd.x; cd[r][1] = vd.y; cd[r][2] = vd.z; cd[r][3] = vd.w;\n        cm[r][0] = vm.x; cm[r][1] = vm.y; cm[r][2] = vm.z; cm[r][3] = vm.w;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int kk = 0; kk < TILE; ++kk) {\n        const uint4 a4d = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sAd[kk * SA_LD + ty * PER_T]);\n        const uint4 a4m = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sAm[kk * SA_LD + ty * PER_T]);\n        const uint4 b4d = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sBd[kk * TILE + tx * PER_T]);\n        const uint4 b4m = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&sBm[kk * TILE + tx * PER_T]);\n        const unsigned int ad[4] = {a4d.x, a4d.y, a4d.z, a4d.w};\n        const unsigned int am[4] = {a4m.x, a4m.y, a4m.z, a4m.w};\n        const unsigned int bd[4] = {b4d.x, b4d.y, b4d.z, b4d.w};\n        const unsigned int bm[4] = {b4m.x, b4m.y, b4m.z, b4m.w};\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int c = 0; c < PER_T; ++c) {\n                relax(cd[r][c], cm[r][c], ad[r] + bd[c], max(am[r], bm[c]));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < PER_T; ++r) {\n        const size_t g = (row0 + ty * PER_T + r) * ld + col0 + tx * PER_T;\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&D[g]) = make_uint4(cd[r][0], cd[r][1], cd[r][2], cd[r][3]);\n        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&M[g]) = make_uint4(cm[r][0], cm[r][1], cm[r][2], cm[r][3]);\n    }\n}\n\n// Convert m-encoding to the original path convention: path[i][j] = m-1, or i if m==0\n__global__ void decodePathKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ M, const size_t ld,\n                                 const size_t rows, const size_t globalRow0) {\n    const size_t total = rows * ld;\n    for (size_t e = blockIdx.x * (size_t)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; e < total;\n         e += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const unsigned int m = M[e];\n        M[e] = m ? m - 1 : (unsigned int)(globalRow0 + e / ld);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Advance an LCG state x -> a*x + c (mod 2^32) by 'steps' steps\nstatic unsigned int lcgJump(unsigned int x, uint64_t steps) {\n    unsigned int a = 1103515245u, c = 12345u;  // glibc rand_r LCG\n    unsigned int accA = 1u, accC = 0u;\n    while (steps) {\n        if (steps & 1) {\n            accA = accA * a;\n            accC = accC * a + c;\n        }\n        c = c * a + c;\n        a = a * a;\n        steps >>= 1;\n    }\n    return accA * x + accC;\n}\n\n// Check that rand_r advances its state by three LCG steps per call (glibc)\nstatic bool randJumpSupported() {\n    unsigned int s = 42;\n    for (int t = 1; t <= 1000; ++t) {\n        rand_r(&s);\n        if (s != lcgJump(42u, 3ull * t)) return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate rows [gRow0, gRow1) of the original distance matrix into a padded\n// row-major local buffer (row stride ld). Matches the sequential rand_r stream exactly.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(unsigned int* dist, const size_t numNodes, const size_t ld,\n                              const size_t gRow0, const size_t gRow1, const size_t padRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const bool jump = randJumpSupported();\n\n    auto genRow = [&](const size_t gi, unsigned int& seed) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + (gi - gRow0) * ld;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            row[j] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n        }\n        for (size_t j = numNodes; j < ld; ++j) row[j] = PAD_DIST;\n        // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n        row[gi] = 0;\n    };\n\n    if (jump) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t gi = gRow0; gi < gRow1; ++gi) {\n            unsigned int seed = lcgJump(42u, 3ull * gi * numNodes);\n            genRow(gi, seed);\n        }\n    } else {\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t s = 0; s < gRow0 * numNodes; ++s) rand_r(&seed);\n        for (size_t gi = gRow0; gi < gRow1; ++gi) genRow(gi, seed);\n    }\n\n    // Padding rows (beyond numNodes): isolated nodes\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t p = 0; p < padRows; ++p) {\n        const size_t gi = gRow1 + p;\n        unsigned int* row = dist + (gi - gRow0) * ld;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < ld; ++j) row[j] = PAD_DIST;\n        row[gi] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Distributed blocked Floyd-Warshall state for one rank\nstruct DistFW {\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    size_t n = 0;      // real number of nodes\n    size_t N = 0;      // *dM = nullptr;           // local rows, row-major, ld = N\n    unsigned int *dPanel[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};        // received row panel: dist | m\n    unsigned int *hPanel[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};        // pinned staging: dist | m\n    cudaStream_t sComp = nullptr, sCopy = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evPanelReady[2], evPanelFree[2], evH2DDone[2], evPanelComputed;\n\n    int tileStart(int r) const {\n        const int base = nb / nranks, extra = nb % nranks;\n        return r * base + std::min(r, extra);\n    }\n    int owner(int kb) const {\n        int lo = 0, hi = nranks - 1;\n        while dependentKernel<0><<<1, dim3(TPB_X, TPB_Y), 0, sComp>>>(\n            dD, dM, N, nullptr, nullptr, 0, lt, kb, -1, kb);\n        unsigned int* rD = dD + (size_t)lt * TILE * N;\n        unsigned int* rM    // Column tiles (local rows) for pivot kb\n    void computeColumn(int kb) {\n        const int nLocal = t1 - t0;\n        if (nLocal <= 0) return;\n        const int skip = (kb >= t0 && kb < t1) ? \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);\n    \n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results_int(dist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n    }\n    \n    // {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfjAPG25tm8DGcZZneqbx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've parallelized `floydwarshall` with MPI + OpenMP + CUDA, using only `floydwarshall.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt`. The executable name and command-line options are unchanged. Output is bit-identical to the original: for both the distance and path matrices, the hashes match across 1–4 ranks and sizes from n=1 to 1024 (including sizes that aren't multiples of the tile size). Validation passes for n=2048 and 4096, and the default n=512 hash matches.\n\n**Performance** (RTX 3090s on one node; times in ms; the original serial code took 9.4 s at n=2048):\n\n| n | 1 GPU | 2 GPUs | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 2048 | 17 | 11 | 15 |\n| 4096 | 76 | 52 | 35 |\n| 8192 | 488 | 259 | 149 |\n| 16384 | 3394 | 1744 | 900 (3.8×) |\n\nAt n=2048 and below there's too little work per step to hide communication, so adding GPUs barely helps. Timing now covers upload, compute and download, which the original didn't need to time.\n\n**How it works**\n- **CUDA:** Floyd-Warshall runs in 64×64 tiles. The bulk of the work is a kernel that keeps its values in registers. The smaller per-step kernels trade values between threads directly instead of waiting on each other 64 times per tile.\n- **Same `path` results:** reordering the computation into tiles would normally change which `k` gets stored in `path`. To prevent that, each entry is computed as the pair (distance, largest intermediate node) and compared in that order. This gives exactly the value the original's \"last `k` that strictly improved\" rule produces.\n- **MPI:** each rank owns a contiguous block of rows on its own GPU. Every step, one rank's row of tiles has to reach all the others:\n  - Within a node it goes through a shared-memory window plus a barrier.\n  - Between nodes, one leader rank per node forwards it.\n  - The rank owning the next row block computes that row early, so sending it overlaps with the main computation.\n- **OpenMP:** generates each rank's rows of the input matrix in parallel. It jumps the random-number generator ahead so the values exactly match the original serial sequence; if the C library's generator isn't the expected one, it falls back to serial generation. It also packs results for the final gather to rank 0, where printing and validation happen.\n\n**Things to know**\n- The path matrix stays split across ranks in host memory and is never gathered, because the original never outputs it. I only checked its hashes with a temporary test build, which I deleted.\n- The build defaults to GPU architectures 7.0, 8.0, 8.6 and 9.0. You can override this with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.\n- Launch with one rank per GPU. Spreading ranks across both CPU sockets (`--bind-to none` or `--map-by ppr:2:numa`) helps a little.\n- Multi-node runs are untested: the code path between nodes exists, but I could only run on one machine."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":211,"cache_read_input_tokens":114496,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":211},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c73f9740-23dd-4e63-8a1f-8d982970b623","uuid":"0cb21c13-b0c9-4142-ba41-ec62e562e06c","timestamp":"2026-10-05T13:23:37.834Z","request_id":"req_011CfjAPFiEWCgCgVtnNPZBH"}
